name: PSM Main Campus (Ruwi)
blurb: Flagship campus of Pakistan Schools Oman in Ruwi. Home to the Board of Directors, central administration, and the network’s widest academic and co-curricular offering.

name: PSM Seeb Branch
address: Building 356, Way 5889, Al Chradi, Al Seeb, Muscat
blurb: Pakistan School Seeb serves families across Al Seeb with a full Kindergarten to Grade 12 programme. Students follow FBISE and Cambridge routes in a community of 1,300+ learners under the Ministry of Education.

name: PSM Sohar Branch
address: Sohar, Al Batinah North, Sultanate of Oman
blurb: Northern campus in Sohar supporting expatriate and local families in Al Batinah North. Shares academic standards, teacher development, and inter-branch events with the wider PSM network.

name: PSM Suwaiq Branch
address: Suwaiq, Al Batinah, Sultanate of Oman
blurb: Suwaiq campus extends quality Pakistani curriculum education along the Al Batinah coast, linked to Muscat through shared policies, assessments, and student activities.

name: PSM Al Buraimi Branch
blurb: Al Buraimi branch serves communities in the north-west, close to the border, with the same academic framework and pastoral care ethos as other Pakistan School Muscat campuses.

name: PSM Nizwa Branch
address: Nizwa, Ad Dakhiliyah, Sultanate of Oman
blurb: Interior campus in Nizwa (Ad Dakhiliyah), bringing the Pakistan Schools Oman experience to families in the heart of the Sultanate with consistent standards and network events.

name: PSM Salalah Branch
blurb: Southern campus in Salalah, Dhofar — one of the network’s established schools serving the southern region with the same commitment to academic excellence and character development.
